subtrees.visible_text: Health Stay one beat ahead. Get meaningful insights about your health just by wearing your Apple Watch SE 3. An innovative wrist temperature sensor enables deeper insights in the Vitals app and retrospective ovulation estimates in the Cycle Tracking app. You’ll also receive a daily sleep score and possible sleep apnea notifications.
